name: Initialize experiment
split: Existing sponsor coins → 330,000 marker sats + sponsor change
notes: Optional bootstrap. Transfers existing coins, not legal budget authority. Fees come from separate sponsor inputs.

name: Record approved program
notes: Record the independently enacted authority and its source. The federal example is scaled inside the city experiment.

name: Apportion current-period authority
notes: The period limit refers to the original authority and its conditions.

name: Allot to the district
notes: Check purpose, amount, and approvals before recording the allotment.

name: Record contract obligation
notes: The contract remains in its authoritative system; evidence links the obligation to the allotment.

name: Attest partial payment
notes: Attest the financial-system payment after work acceptance and reconciliation. Marker sats remain in demo custody.

name: Attest later final payment
notes: This is a later event, beyond the live dashboard snapshot. The final payment occurs in the financial system.

name: Reconciliation checkpoint
notes: Optional checkpoint. Paid markers stay historical; reconciliation does not release fresh budget authority.

name: Record approved adjustment
notes: Consume current unspent remainders. The period ceiling increases from 2,500 to 3,000; descendants remain intact.
